entities.summary: Nicaragua is a sovereign nation in Central America, Americas. Its capital is Managua. Official languages include Spanish. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic (de jure authoritarian regime de facto). Population: approximately 7.0 million. Area: 130,373 km². Comprehensive index for Nicaragua covering Chorotegas/Nicarao indigenous peoples, Columbus/Spanish conquest, Granada/León rivalry, Walker filibuster+burning Granada 1856, independence 1821, liberal vs conservative wars, Zelaya liberal reforms, US interventions (1912-33, banana/canal interests), Augusto Sándino resistance (original Sandinista), Somoza Dynasty 1936-79 (43 years), Sandinista Revolution 1979, FSLN (Ortega), Contra War (Reagan's 'freedom fighters', Iran-Contra), Chamorro presidency, and Ortega dictatorship (2007-present).
